attributes.label: Elevation
attributes.source: LOLA DEM LDEM_80S_40MPP_ADJ (Barker et al. 2023, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1)
attributes.method: Height above the 1737.4 km reference sphere

attributes.label: Mean slope
attributes.source: LOLA DEM LDEM_80S_40MPP_ADJ (Barker et al. 2023, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1)
attributes.method: Central-difference gradient of the 40 m DEM within a 1 km radius (1969 pixels), corrected for the polar stereographic scale factor (k = 1.00173)

attributes.label: Max slope
attributes.source: LOLA DEM LDEM_80S_40MPP_ADJ (Barker et al. 2023, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1)
attributes.method: Central-difference gradient of the 40 m DEM within a 1 km radius (1969 pixels), corrected for the polar stereographic scale factor (k = 1.00173)

attributes.label: Slope reference radius
attributes.method: Radius of the circle used for the slope statistics
